CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Winter-2017 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Winter-2017 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 597 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 2 benchmark sites in 2 regions spanning 2 states (survey period: June 2017 to June 2017). These surveys captured 62 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 8 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 599 cards across 55 sites, with 16.2% showing evidence of mouse activity (97 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 248 transects across 56 sites (survey period: June 2017 to July 2017), detecting active burrows in 35.9% of transects (total: 236 active burrows).
